name: logo-results-grid
title: Logo results grid
description: A customer wall where every logo carries one line of outcome and a link to the story, so each name earns its place.
docs: Pass title, an optional description and items ({ name, mark?, result, metric?, href? }); six to nine read best, and a count that does not tile still ends on a full row. Each hairline cell shows the mark (an SVG or image drawn about 28px tall in the text colour; the name is set as text without one), the result in plain words and, with an href, a quiet 'Read the story' arrow. The figure inside the result is medium weight in tabular digits: give metric exactly as it appears in result ('41 percent'), or leave it out and the first number with its unit is used. A cell with an href is one link as a whole (focus ring inside, the arrow moves on hover); a cell without one is not a link and has no arrow. Three columns from 1024px, two from 640px, one on a phone; when the last row is short, its last cell stretches across the free columns (all three for a seventh, two for an eighth, both on two columns for an odd one), so no blank cell is left behind. labels.readStory translates the arrow line. Renders on the server.
